Complete Season One'' |publisher=[[Buena Vista Home Entertainment]] |release date=[[August 20]], [[2019]]{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-season-one-dvd|text=''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One Coming to DVD on August 20|date=2019-07-23}} |runtime=462 minutes |upc=786936865417 |isbn= |media type=[[Wikipedia:DVD|DVD]] |resolution=480p |ratio=1.78:1 |audio=*English 5.1 Dolby *French 2.0 Dolby *Spanish 2.0 Dolby |subtitles=*English SDH *French *Spanish }} '''''Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One''''' is a DVD compilation of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]''. It was released by [[Buena Vista Home Entertainment]] on [[August 20]], [[2019]]. ==Publisher's summary== ''Recruited by Poe Dameron for a top secret Resistance mission, hotshot pilot Kazuda "Kaz" Xiono finds himself in over his head when he and BB-8 are stationed aboard a large aircraft refueling station. Join Kaz on this high-flying adventure as he struggles to keep his cover as a mechanic and gets entangled with ace pilots, marauding pirates, villainous stormtroopers, and other colorful characters.'' ==Contents== *[[Star Wars Resistance Season One|''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One]] – twenty-one episodes and twelve shorts *"[[Path of Resistance]]," a video hosted by supervising director [[Justin Ridge]] *Cast audio commentaries featuring [[Christopher Sean]] (voice of Kazuda Xiono), [[Myrna Velasco]] (voice of [[Torra Doza]]), [[Scott Lawrence]] (voice of [[Jarek Yeager]]), and [[Josh Brener]] (voice of [[Neeku Vozo]]) **"[[The High Tower]]" **"[[The Platform Classic]]" **"[[Bibo (episode)|Bibo]]" **"[[No Escape: Part 2]]" *''[[Resistance Rewind]]'', episodes 1.1–1.22 ==Media== ===Editions=== *UPC 786936865417; [[August 20]], [[2019]]; [[Buena Vista Home Entertainment, Inc.]]; US DVD{{BN|url=w/dvd-star-wars-resistance-season-1/34075894|text=Star Wars Resistance: Season 1}} ===Cover gallery=== File:StarWarsResistanceCompleteSeasonOne-Cover.png|Product view File:ResistanceSeasonOneDVD-back.png|Back cover ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-season-one-dvd|text=''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One Coming to DVD on August 20}} *{{StarWarsShow|VnSRbZwJiNM|We Brushed Kylo Ren's Hair at San Diego Comic-Con|sw_url=video/we-brushed-kylo-ren-s-hair-at-san-diego-comic-con}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{BN|url=w/dvd-star-wars-resistance-season-1/34075894|text=Star Wars Resistance: Season 1}} {{Interlang |ka=ვარსკვლავური ომები: წინააღმდეგობა: სრული პირველი სეზონი }} [[Category:Star Wars Resistance]] [[Category:Television home video releases]]
